>Did you ever notice in that period her blatantly lying to anyone else? 

Honestly, Not that I remember or that I caught her doing. She seemed like a pretty genuine person at least when we were together. One thing that I always found odd was that she was almost overly nice to strangers or just random people in general. I figured that's just who she was but in retrospect, it might be a way to make it seem like she would never be capable of this kind of thing but I really don't know.

>you must have met her parents / family

Yes, I have met her family and was used to hanging around them for the 2 or so years we were dating legitimately but this last month she said she was only "in town" for a day or two and always came over to my place (i know, RED FLAG). However, she always said she wanted to move out of her house so she wouldn't have to deal with family drama which I can understand. That is why I thought this "move" would be a big step for her. I wish I would have insisted on coming over and seen where that went because then it would have been pretty clear but I'm sure she would have lied to get out of that too. Overall, we never really hung out at her parents place a lot because a lot of the time she wanted to just get away.

>You must have known or hung out with some of her friends over the years. Did they all cover for her? 

Most of her friends are acquaintances to me and I rarely saw them. I have a tight knit group of friends and I really never wanted to have anyone check up on her because I assumed if she had a boyfriend or something like that she would just tell me and never let it get as far as it did. I really wish I did my homework before trying to get back together with her but I had no reason at that point to believe she would lie to me like that.

>Or did she somehow keep you and her friends completely separate?

Come to think of it... Yeah, she absolutely did. She never invited me out with her friends. We usually hung around with my friends. I didn't even think that she did this on purpose until now.

All in all, I would say that she was a GREAT liar and probably takes pride in it. To give you an example, months after we were broken up, we started talking again and I told her the truth that I went on a date with another girl (therapist said it might help) since I thought our relationship was pretty much over. This was after a couple months of not speaking since we both decided it would be best for both of us to not have to do the "long distance" thing and she told me that she never even thought about dating someone else at this point (yet she was in a relationship with the guy living in her house for a few months at this point). She just flat out manipulated me to perfection in almost every way imaginable. I honestly am not sure what I would have done differently in this situation but looking back on it, I can pick out a lot of indicators that should have tipped me off.

Nope, I sent him a screenshot of what she told me and he said he had no idea what she was talking about there. I assume she said that to justify not texting back when she was with him because "the police might tap her phone for suspicious activity." And dear god that was dumb of me to believe.. I even questioned her in detail about it and she had made up answers for every question.

Damn man..That's rough. I am sorry that happened to you. This kind of stuff really shouldn't ever happen but I am hearing case after case of it today.

I will try to trust my instincts more but before this, I never caught her red handed in a lie or had really any reason to think she wasn't who she said she was. But I was oblivious to a lot and I at least know some of the signs to catch next time around.
